theme.name: Executive Ledger

style.overall: Minimal executive financial reporting with disciplined whitespace and clear data hierarchy
style.graphic_style: Clean flat charts, precise grids, and restrained callout highlights

theme.exclusions: Avoid gradients, decorative illustrations, stock photography, dense dashboard layouts, playful colors, and 3D effects.

mockup.source_prompt:
Render the title slide of a presentation, edge to edge. The presentation is about: Q4 2025 Financial Results

Design it in the following theme:

# name: Executive Ledger

# colors

## primary: #102A43

## secondary: #486581

## accent: #B7791F

## background: #F7F9FC

## text_primary: #102A43

## text_secondary: #52606D

# typography

## font_family: Helvetica

## heading_style: Bold, sentence case, restrained hierarchy

## body_style: Regular, highly legible, concise

# layout

## aspect_ratio: 16:9

## margins: wide

## alignment: left

# style

## overall: Minimal executive financial reporting with disciplined whitespace and clear data hierarchy

## icon_style: Fine-line outline icons

## graphic_style: Clean flat charts, precise grids, and restrained callout highlights

# exclusions: Avoid gradients, decorative illustrations, stock photography, dense dashboard layouts, playful colors, and 3D effects.

---

One slide only, filling the whole image: the deck's title large, taken from its topic word for word, a short subtitle, and the theme's palette, type and graphic style. No device frame, no mosaic, no border around the slide.

typography.heading_style: Bold serif headings with measured sentence case

theme.exclusions: Avoid gradients, saturated multicolor charts, novelty fonts, casual imagery, excessive animation, and ornamental graphics.
